description: This file contains test functions for the AgentStatus struct and related helper methods, verifying behavior such as health logic, state transitions, lifecycle status mappings, and heartbeat updates.

classes.name: AgentStatus
classes.description: Struct representing the status of an agent, including its state, health score, lifecycle status, and related information.

classes.name: StateTransition
classes.description: Struct representing a transition from one agent state to another.

classes.name: MCPStatusInfo
classes.description: Struct encapsulating status information from MCP (Managed Control Plane).

methods.name: IsHealthy
methods.description: Returns true if the agent's health score indicates a healthy state; false otherwise.

methods.name: IsTransitioning
methods.description: Returns true if the agent is currently in a state transition.

methods.name: GetEffectiveState
methods.description: Determines the agent's effective state, considering ongoing transitions.

methods.name: ToLegacyHealthStatus
methods.description: Converts the current health score and state to a legacy health status string.

methods.name: ToLegacyLifecycleStatus
methods.description: Converts the agent's current state and health to a legacy lifecycle status.

methods.name: NewAgentStatus
methods.description: Factory function to create a new AgentStatus instance with default values.

methods.name: FromLegacyStatus
methods.description: Creates an AgentStatus object based on legacy health and lifecycle status inputs.

methods.name: UpdateFromHeartbeat
methods.description: Updates the agent status based on heartbeat information received.

methods.name: StartTransition
methods.description: Initiates a state transition to a new agent state.

methods.name: CompleteTransition
methods.description: Completes an ongoing state transition, updating the agent's state accordingly.
